resources.string:
Enter the address of the Neurio server you want to use — the computer running `npm run server`. Examples:

• http://192.168.1.20:8790 (server on your Wi-Fi)
• https://chat.example.com (self-hosted with TLS)

Long-press anywhere in the app to change it later.
Sign out and clear local data
Neurio needs microphone access for voice channels.
Neurio needs camera access for video calls.
Voice and video need microphone/camera permission. Enable them in Android settings, then try again.
Long-press anywhere to change the server address.
